notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Upgraded engine to Godot 4.4.1 - this may fix some crashes.
[*]Fixed inconsistencies with the arrow indicator during dialogue.
[*]Fixed shadow detail to be closer to how it looked before patch 2.
[*]Fixed scrolling credits being on-screen before they're supposed to.
[*]Fixed some light bleed issues near the start of the game.
[*]Better distributed detail in lightmaps, reducing filesize and increasing quality in many areas.
[*]Increased the resolution of the in-game logo.
[/list]

If you have any technical issues with the game, please report them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2565520/discussions/0/4842023530178552158/]here[/url].

notes.title: Patch 2 + IGF Finalist
notes.content:
Year Unknown is a finalist for [i]Best Student Game[/i] at the 2025 Independent Games Festival Awards! Watch the award ceremony this Wednesday 3/19 at 6:30 PT: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/gdc]https://www.twitch.tv/gdc[/url]

In other news, a new update is available, making the game playable on more systems:
[list]
[*]Upgraded engine to Godot 4.4
[list]
[*]The game is now playable on older systems that don't support Vulkan. Some effects are changed or disabled.
[*]This may or may not solve some stuttering issues in the second area.
[/list]
[*]Added invert y option for keyboard+mouse
[*]Fixed missing controller icons on menu when no controller is connected
[*]Simplified collisions in the final area
[*]Drastically reduced the size of the main menu lightmap. This should improve the time it takes to start up the game.
[/list]

If you have any technical issues with the game, please report them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2565520/discussions/0/4842023530178552158/]here[/url]. Thanks for playing!
